heading: Build More Than Marks.
philosophy: Academic scores open initial doors; character, articulation, and resilience build lifelong success. Chakra's personality development modules empower students to lead with conviction.

journeySteps.title: Academic Foundation
journeySteps.desc: Deep subject mastery, analytical problem solving, and conceptual clarity in an encouraging learning space.

journeySteps.title: Habit & Consistency
journeySteps.desc: Mastering daily routines, punctuality, and self-governance to navigate complex academic challenges.

journeySteps.title: Physical Endurance
journeySteps.desc: Sportsmanship, team bonding, resilience, and stress relief through active physical participation.

journeySteps.title: Self-Confidence
journeySteps.desc: Public speaking, critical debate, and personal poise overcoming stage fear and hesitation.

journeySteps.title: Leadership & Ethics
journeySteps.desc: Empathy, team leadership, collaborative problem-solving, and sound moral judgment for future citizenship.

facets.title: Communication & Elocution
facets.desc: Structured speaking workshops, articulate English diction, and podium practice to express thoughts clearly.

facets.title: Poise & Self-Confidence
facets.desc: Overcoming stage anxiety through interactive group presentations, peer discussions, and mock forums.

facets.title: Leadership & Ethics
facets.desc: Student club initiatives, event organization roles, and ethical decision-making exercises.

facets.title: Collaborative Synergy
facets.desc: Peer study groups, team science projects, and sports squads cultivating mutual respect and cooperation.

facets.title: Time Mastery & Focus
facets.desc: Prioritization strategies, balanced routine management between studies, sports, and adequate rest.

facets.title: Analytical Presentation
facets.desc: Structuring thoughts logically into coherent presentations, research posters, and reasoned arguments.
